9.name: By a Whisker
9.overview: Stan is a suspect in the murder of Liesbeth Kraai. While in the detention center, he runs into an old acquaintance: Patrick Boateng, a member of the Panga Boïs. Noucha investigates a potential alibi for Stan, but in doing so, she finds herself in serious trouble so serious, in fact, that Dries and Carolien are forced to abandon their own investigation into an art heist to come to her aid.

9.name: Van Gogh
9.overview: Carolien and Dries resume their investigation into the stolen Van Gogh painting. Meanwhile, Karel Zoet sees his hopes for the artwork’s recovery slowly fading; progress on the case is sluggish, and the likelihood of its return diminishes as the mastermind behind the theft ruthlessly wipes away any traces. Noucha and Stan uncover a connection between Liesbeth and a Nigerian crime syndicate.

9.name: The Vampire Hunter
9.overview: Carolien and Dries are involved in the investigation into a murder in a remote nature reserve. The first lead brings them into contact with a disturbed individual, which adds a complex twist to the investigation. After consulting with Karel Zoet, Carolien makes an unexpected and far-reaching decision—one that could have a major impact on the further course of the case.

9.name: Dirty Money
9.overview: Dries and his new partner are tasked with investigating a violent robbery of a discreet, high-value transport, during which the passenger was killed by a gunshot wound. Meanwhile, Carolien continues her search for the trail of the Van Gogh painting, acting on behalf of the Zoet family.
